paper.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition

result.summary: 本文针对深度神经网络难以训练的问题，提出了残差学习框架，让堆叠层学习相对于输入的残差映射而非无参照映射 [S1.p5]。作者在 ImageNet 上评估了最深达 152 层的残差网络，其复杂度仍低于 VGG 网络 [abstract]，并在 CIFAR-10 上分析了 100 层和 1000 层网络 [abstract]。实验表明极深残差网络易于优化，能随深度增加获得精度提升，而对应的普通网络深度增加时训练误差反而更高 [S1.p7]。152 层单模型在 ImageNet 验证集上取得 4.49% 的 top-5 误差，六模型集成在测试集上取得 3.57% 的 top-5 误差，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 分类任务第一名 [S4.SS1.p16]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：随着网络加深，训练难度增加，且存在退化问题——普通网络深度增加时训练误差反而更高 [S1.p7]。其动机在于网络深度对图像分类至关重要，领先的 ImageNet 结果都使用了十六到三十层的极深模型 [S1.p1]。作者提出疑问：学习更好的网络是否像堆叠更多层一样简单 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: Recent evidence reveals that network depth is of crucial importance, and the leading results on the challenging ImageNet dataset all exploit “very deep” models, with a depth of sixteen to thirty.
Driven by the significance of depth, a question arises: Is learning better networks as easy as stacking more layers?
Our extremely deep residual nets are easy to optimize, but the counterpart “plain” nets (that simply stack layers) exhibit higher training error when the depth increases

method.text: 论文提出深度残差学习框架，显式地让堆叠的非线性层拟合残差映射 F(x):=H(x)-x，将原始映射重铸为 F(x)+x [S1.p5]。作者假设优化残差映射比优化原始无参照映射更容易 [S1.p5]。在 ImageNet 实现中，采用批归一化、SGD（mini-batch 256，学习率从 0.1 开始，误差平台时除以 10，训练最多 60×10^4 次迭代，权重衰减 0.0001，动量 0.9），不使用 dropout [S3.SS4.p1]。

evidence.quote: we explicitly let these layers fit a residual mapping.
We hypothesize that it is easier to optimize the residual mapping than to optimize the original, unreferenced mapping.
We adopt batch normalization (BN) right after each convolution and before activation, following.
We use SGD with a mini-batch size of 256.
The learning rate starts from 0.1 and is divided by 10 when the error plateaus, and the models are trained for up to $60\times 10^{4}$ iterations.
We use a weight decay of 0.0001 and a momentum of 0.9.
We do not use dropout, following the practice in.

experiments.text: 论文在 ImageNet 分类数据集上评估了 18 层和 34 层残差网络，并与对应的普通网络比较 [S4.SS1.p5]。在 CIFAR-10 数据集（50k 训练图像、10k 测试图像、10 类）上进行了更多研究，使用简单架构，输入为 32×32 图像，网络为 6n+2 层堆叠加权层，滤波器数为 {16,32,64} [S4.SS2.p1][S4.SS2.p2]。此外，在 PASCAL VOC 2007/2012 和 MS COCO 目标检测任务上，采用 Faster R-CNN，将 VGG-16 替换为 ResNet-101 进行验证 [S4.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: Next we evaluate 18-layer and 34-layer residual nets ( ResNets).
We conducted more studies on the CIFAR-10 dataset, which consists of 50k training images and 10k testing images in 10 classes.
The network inputs are 32 $\times$ 32 images, with the per-pixel mean subtracted.
There are totally 6 $n$ +2 stacked weighted layers.
The numbers of filters are $\{16,32,64\}$ respectively.
We adopt Faster R-CNN as the detection method.
Here we are interested in the improvements of replacing VGG-16 with ResNet-101.

findings.text: 在 ImageNet 上，34 层 ResNet 比 18 层 ResNet 更好（提升 2.8%），且 34 层 ResNet 训练误差更低并能泛化到验证数据，表明退化问题得到解决 [S4.SS1.p6]。与对应的普通网络相比，34 层 ResNet 将 top-1 误差降低 3.5% [S4.SS1.p7]。152 层 ResNet 单模型在验证集上取得 4.49% 的 top-5 误差，优于所有先前集成结果；六模型集成在测试集上取得 3.57% 的 top-5 误差，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 第一名 [S4.SS1.p16]。在 CIFAR-10 上，ResNet 同样克服优化困难，随深度增加获得精度提升 [S4.SS2.p5]。在 COCO 目标检测上，ResNet-101 相比 VGG-16 在 mAP@[.5,.95] 上提升 6.0%，相对提升 28% [S4.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: the 34-layer ResNet is better than the 18-layer ResNet (by 2.8%).
the 34-layer ResNet exhibits considerably lower training error and is generalizable to the validation data.
the 34-layer ResNet reduces the top-1 error by 3.5% (Table 2), resulting from the successfully reduced training error
Our 152-layer ResNet has a single-model top-5 validation error of 4.49%.
This single-model result outperforms all previous ensemble results (Table 5).
This leads to 3.57% top-5 error on the test set (Table 5).
This entry won the 1st place in ILSVRC 2015.
our ResNets manage to overcome the optimization difficulty and demonstrate accuracy gains when the depth increases.
we obtain a 6.0% increase in COCO’s standard metric (mAP@[.5,.95]), which is a 28% relative improvement.

limitations.text: 作者指出，在 CIFAR-10 上 1202 层网络的测试结果比 110 层网络更差，尽管两者训练误差相似，作者认为这是因为过拟合，1202 层网络对此小数据集可能不必要地大（19.4M） [S4.SS2.p9]。本文未使用 maxout/dropout，仅通过深而窄的架构施加正则化，作者表示结合更强正则化可能改善结果，留待未来研究 [S4.SS2.p9]。

evidence.quote: The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error.
We argue that this is because of overfitting.
The 1202-layer network may be unnecessarily large (19.4M) for this small dataset.
In this paper, we use no maxout/dropout and just simply impose regularization via deep and thin architectures by design
But combining with stronger regularization may improve results, which we will study in the future.
